<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<style>
*{
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    box-sizing:border-box;
}

html,
body{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#ffffff;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;
}

body{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:20px;
}

form{
    width:100%;
    max-width:380px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:16px;
}

input{
    width:100%;
    height:52px;
    padding:0 16px;
    border:1px solid #d9d9d9;
    border-radius:10px;
    background:#fff;
    color:#111;
    font-size:16px;
    outline:none;
}

input:focus{
    border-color:#111;
}

button{
    width:100%;
    height:52px;
    border:none;
    border-radius:10px;
    background:#111;
    color:#fff;
    font-size:16px;
    font-weight:600;
    cursor:pointer;
}

button:active{
    transform:scale(.99);
}

@media (max-width:480px){
    body{
        padding:16px;
    }
}
</style>
</head>

<body>

<form>
    <input
        type="email"
        name="email"
        placeholder="Email"
        autocomplete="email"
        required
    >

    <input
        type="password"
        name="password"
        placeholder="Password"
        autocomplete="current-password"
        required
    >

    <button type="submit">Continue</button>
</form>

</body>
</html>
